review_description: This company is extremely unprofessional.1. Their sales team have zero knowledge of the products they are offering. We were told they could add more panels, then said they couldn't, and the reasoning they provided was incorrect (first they said because of the inverter - wrong, then because of Western Power - wrong, then we finally got the correct answer).2. They changed inverter models between quotes without informing. Then denied it at first.3. The STC credit amount they offer is well below market rate. They offered $35/STC, where every other installer offers $38, with the market sale rate being $40 (at the time of the quote).4. Once their installers showed up to site, they forced a $350 increase in the price because of where they needed to install the inverter (in a shaded area). The location chosen was in our patio, and space that we use often. Other suitable locations would have been the back of the house out of site, and a small nook protected from the sun. The quote I agreed to was for a compliant installation, and it is their own fault for not actually attending the house for a pre-install/quote inspection. The additional cost for the inverter install was a 10% increase to the original quote.

Overall package from Zip was well priced. Picked up a 10kw system with 20kw battery and two of the house circuits on power out back up for similar price to quotes received through SolarQuotes. Previous experience with follow up issues has made us not believe the dearer installers are necessarily going to help out down the track, though I think they are more likely to if they are mentioned favourably on SolarQuotes.20kw battery isn't sufficient for us. We knew this. It will dramatically reduce our bill though. Our self sufficiency was running above 90% but a couple of big trips has meant the EV was charging overnight and has dragged that down.Only installed about 6 weeks ago.Rough calculations indicating pay off in 3.5 to 4 years. (our calculations)Contractors were good. No problems so far with install and operation.No bullying BS form Zip before the sign up at all, which was a shock. Sorry for the pun.Cheers

Only issues were with Energex..  they don't appear to want solar in embedded networks. Zip and the subcontracted installer were both excellent.The system went in at the first attempt after months of bureaucratic delays, came up immediately and has run faultlessly ever since. I've seen complaints about the app being difficult to configure but I had no problems but then again I have an IT background. 100% happy with our solar system!
These guys did a great job, knocked a few thousand off the going rate and installed within a fortnight...Others were suggesting 2 month lead times.

Salesman knowledge average.Nothing wrong with their attitude just understanding what they are saying and long distance connections made it hard.All grid connections and compliance were fine.Make sure you read up about regs and specs so you as the customer are informed.This also helps with explaining  to installer where you would like inverter/battery location vs regulations, which dictate certain distances from inverter and battery etc.
Installation was great, on the day I requested, very polite and professional.
If you're in a strata embedded network and thinking of installing solar be prepared for a rough ride.

I had old panels to be removed and I presumed it’s part of the quoted price. It was not. So I had to pay for that. The rest was good, but a bit on panel positioning were not spelt out on my thought. But system is great and producing good energy; my bills have dropped off significantly, but no battery, for overnight storage.

The sales process was efficient, clear and concise. Knowledgeable, able to answer all of my questions. Unfortunately, the installation occurred about 2 months after the original planned date due to some unforeseen circumstances. However, when a new date was locked in, everything went well for the installation. The installation team arrived early, ahead of time, and got to work with no fuss, very punctual. Everything was installed without a hiccup, and cleaned up well, there was no mess at all left behind. Lovely clean neat installation, very professional. This has only just been installed, so this is early days I realize, but so far brilliant.
Everything organised through installer, punctual, follow up questions quickly resolved.
Very good installation at a good price.Good customer service too
System is 3 phase growatt 5kw Inverter with 370w longi 18 panels of a 6.66kw system.

The sales/quoting process provided all of the information needed to compare quality, prices and systems.The installation was completed on the scheduled day and the installers were very punctual, but did leave some bits and pieces of rubbish for me to clean up which was a little disappointing.The installer gave me a run through of how the system works and advised that I would need to contact my power provider to install an upgrade to my meter box.  I was also provided with a manual for the inverter.

Zip Solar are great at selling their product though after sales support is lacking and requires some work. I suggest you purchase elsewhere and check if they are a licensed solar selling retailer as per your states regulations which I wish I knew was a thing before purchasing. Having the system installed by a licensed installer is not good enough, the business needs to have a license also.The installer(Not a ZIP Solar employee) I had on the day was good and explained everything well though.
Sales team were brilliantInstallation team advised and explained each stepInstaller was excellent, went above expectationsGreat team effort at a great price.

Sales and quoting was quick, a few phone calls but respected my time to make a decision.Installation was quick with excellent communication and contact made quickly with part supply issues.Extra consumption monitor added as recommended from here.Still early days but looking great so far.Price came in cheaper with same parts used and had a few referrals from friends.
